name: Baron Marinous
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>Stairs descending down in Mathystra? Could be it be?<Onu shakes his head.>I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.
narrative.requestItemsText: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, friend... what have you brought me?
